notablePrerequisites: Your commander is on the battlefield.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Loyal Apprentice triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Myrs and Thopter, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
